title: This was definitely NOT on my 2026 Bingo card but WOW am I excited fo...
transcript: Lin Manuel Miranda is back directing another film and he has once again chosen one of my favourite niche off Broadway musicals that the general public has never heard of. He obviously made his directorial debut a few years ago with Tick Tick Boom. Now he's returning to the director seat directing octet by Dave Malloy. And if you haven't heard of octet, go listen to octet because it's amazing, but it's also a wild choice to turn into a film. Octet is an acapella chamber musical exploring internet addiction. It takes place at an internet addict support group meeting. The entire show takes place at this one meeting, and there isn't really an overarching plot as much as we are just taking turns learning about each of these different characters, similar to like A Chorus Line or cats. Which of course, raises the question, how do you adapt a show that ostensibly has no plot to film? I mean, both of those shows that I mentioned earlier, A Chorus Line and cats, both attempted film adaptations and both failed. And honestly, if any other person was directing this, I would feel really worried. But if anyone can make it work, it's Lin Manuel Miranda. He's a huge theatre kid, he loves this material and is one of the few people that I think understands both theatre and film as mediums very intimately. he knows how to translate something that is inherently theatrical into film without losing what Made it so special in the first place. So, yeah, I'm totally sold.
classificationReason: Creator discusses Lin Manuel Miranda directing a FILM adaptation of Octet. This is a film announcement, not a stage production on the list. Octet itself is not on the list either.
